moments.title: Love Island UK crowns winners
moments.blurb: Julia Majchrzak and Lorenzo Alessi were crowned the winners of Love Island UK 2026 in a dramatic live finale on Monday, July 27, taking home the £50,000 prize.

angles.name: The Big Win
angles.copy: Julia & Lorenzo! Your Love Island UK 2026 winners were crowned on Monday. Did the right couple win the £50k? #LoveIslandUK

angles.name: Finale Drama

angles.name: Three Couples Final
angles.copy: For the first time ever, Love Island UK had a three-couple final after a shock dumping. Was it the right move for the show? #LoveIsland2026

moments.title: Shakira & Burna Boy top UK Singles Chart
moments.blurb: Shakira & Burna Boy's 'Dai Dai' hit Number 1 on the Official UK Singles Chart for the week ending August 1st, 2026, marking a new chart-topper following the World Cup.

angles.name: New Number 1
angles.copy: New UK Number 1 alert! Shakira & Burna Boy's 'Dai Dai' is officially the biggest track in the country this week. Is it on your playlist? #UKChart

angles.name: Chart Toppers
angles.copy: From World Cup anthem to UK chart champion: Shakira & Burna Boy's 'Dai Dai' reigns supreme at Number 1. What's your favourite current hit?

angles.name: This Week's Hits
angles.copy: Shakira & Burna Boy lead the Official UK Singles Chart! Also charting high are Taylor Swift, Alex Warren, and Olivia Dean. Tune in for the biggest hits!

moments.title: Boardmasters Festival kicks off next week
moments.blurb: Boardmasters Festival, the UK's biggest surf and music festival, returns to Watergate Bay and Fistral Beach in Cornwall from August 5-9, 2026, featuring acts like Fatboy Slim, The Kooks, and Dizzee Rascal.

angles.name: Countdown to Boardmasters
angles.copy: Get ready, Cornwall! Boardmasters Festival kicks off next week, August 5-9, bringing huge music and surf action to Watergate Bay & Fistral Beach. Who are you buzzing to see?

angles.name: Boardmasters Lineup
angles.copy: Fatboy Slim, The Kooks, Dizzee Rascal, James Arthur... the Boardmasters lineup is massive! It all starts August 5th in Cornwall. #CornwallEvents

angles.name: Westcountry Festival Vibes
angles.copy: The countdown is on for Boardmasters! Surfing, sunsets, and sensational music. If you're heading to Cornwall next week, get ready for an epic time! #Westcountry
